'''2013 Alderaan Regionals Clayton Atkin DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Clayton Atkin]] at [[2013 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Username:''' Clayton Atkin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
